title: An Exterior-Embedding Neural Operator Framework for Preserving Conservation Laws

problem.claim: Neural operators for conservation-law-governed PDEs do not reliably satisfy conservation properties, degrading performance and limiting generalizability.

gap.claim: Existing specialized neural-operator architectures do not generalize effectively across distinct PDE problem domains.

contributions.claim: The authors propose Exterior-Embedded Conservation Framework (ECF), a universal framework designed to integrate with data-driven neural operators and strictly enforce conservation laws in predictions.
ECF combines a conservation quantity encoder with a decoder that uses extracted conserved quantities to adjust neural-operator predictions.
The authors report a theoretical proof that enforcing conservation laws enhances model performance.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The method was evaluated on adiabatic systems, shallow water equations, and the Allen-Cahn problem.
The authors report improved model accuracy while strictly enforcing conservation laws in predictions.

narrative_sequence.summary: Neural operators accelerate the solution of time-dependent PDEs by learning governing physical laws from data.
They fail to satisfy conservation properties for conservation-law-governed PDEs, and specialized architectures generalize poorly across problem domains.
ECF integrates conservation-quantity encoding and prediction adjustment into data-driven neural operators to enforce conservation.
The authors report theoretical and experimental support across multiple conservation-law-constrained PDE scenarios.

source_observation.claim: The abstract links poor cross-domain generalization to problem-specific optimal architectures.

interpretation.claim: A reusable model framework may need to separate shared physical constraints from problem-specific prediction behavior.

application.claim: When designing models for multiple PDE domains, encode invariant physical quantities explicitly and use them to constrain outputs.

exception.claim: The abstract does not establish whether this framework generalizes beyond the reported conservation-law-constrained PDE scenarios.

unknowns: No quantitative results, metrics, or comparison details are provided.
The abstract does not specify the neural operators, baselines, datasets, or training procedures used.
The theoretical proof conditions and scope are not described.
